name: SEMCO Technologies Société anonyme
summary: SEMCO Technologies Société anonyme designs, manufactures, and markets components for the manufacturing of semiconductor devices in France, Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company offers electrostatic chucks offer smart solutions for the clamping and processing of various types of wafers; and design and manufacture of gas-cooled components. It serves OEMs, semiconductor fabs, foundries, and laboratories. SEMCO Technologies Société anonyme was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Castries, France. SEMCO Technologies Société anonyme operates as a subsidiary of ECM Technologies SA.
